title: ContactExplorer: Contact Coverage-Guided Exploration for General-Purpose Dexterous Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2603.10971v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning explores effectively in domains such as Atari games, navigation, and locomotion, where novelty over states or dynamics is a sufficient signal. In contrast, dexterous manipulation requires rich physical hand--object interactions, but existing methods often suffer from unstable contact-based novelty signals, inefficient distance novelty signals, or reliance on task-specific priors. We propose ContactExplorer, a general exploration method for dexterous manipulation tasks. ContactExplorer represents contact as the intersection between object surface points and hand keypoints, encouraging dexterous hands to discover diverse and novel contact patterns, namely which fingers contact which object regions. It maintains a contact counter conditioned on discretized object states obtained via learned hash codes. translated_title: ContactExplorer：面向通用灵巧操作的接触覆盖引导探索方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习在Atari游戏、导航和运动控制等领域中探索效果显著，因为在这些领域中，基于状态或动力学的新颖性就足以作为探索信号。相比之下，灵巧操作需要丰富的手-物物理交互，但现有方法往往存在基于接触的新颖性信号不稳定、基于距离的新颖性信号效率低下，或依赖任务特定先验等问题。我们提出了ContactExplorer，一种面向灵巧操作任务的通用探索方法。ContactExplorer将接触表示为物体表面点与手部关键点的交集，鼓励灵巧手发现多样且新颖的接触模式，即哪些手指接触物体的哪些区域。它维护一个接触计数器，该计数器以通过学习到的哈希编码获得的离散化物体状态为条件。该计数器以两种互补的方式被利用：（1）一种基于计数的接触覆盖奖励，用于促进……
tldr: 提出ContactExplorer，一种通过将接触表示为物体表面点与手部关键点的交集、并利用基于学习哈希编码的接触计数器构建计数式接触覆盖奖励，从而鼓励灵巧手发现多样新颖接触模式的通用灵巧操作探索方法。
en_tdlr: ContactExplorer is a general-purpose exploration method for dexterous manipulation that represents contacts as intersections between object surface points and hand keypoints, and uses count-based contact coverage rewards from a contact counter conditioned on learned hash codes to encourage diverse and novel contact patterns.
